The 12-month percent change is (later/earlier - 1) * 100, rounded half up to 4 decimal places.
Both window endpoints must be stored. Intermediate months are not required and are not interpolated.
Historical rank is 1 plus the count of stored values strictly below the latest.
limitations: This is industrial production, not GDP.
Census advance orders were not collected.
A missing 12-month endpoint fails the window and is not interpolated.
